faqs.title: Do we need photography, films or both?
faqs.answer: Photographs give you individual moments to print, share and put in an album. Films add voices, movement and sound. Start with what you would actually like to revisit, then decide which events need each kind of coverage.
faqs.confirm: Confirm the photo-and-film combination and crew for each event.

faqs.title: What is the difference between candid and traditional photographs?
faqs.answer: Candid coverage follows moments as they unfold. Directed portraits and traditional group photographs involve some guidance and arrangement. A celebration can include both: natural interactions alongside organised photographs with your important people.
faqs.confirm: Agree on the balance you prefer before the day.

faqs.title: Can a small or at-home wedding still have thoughtful coverage?
faqs.answer: A smaller celebration can have meaningful family moments, portraits and rituals. Share your venue, approximate guest count and events so the coverage can be shaped around what is actually happening.
faqs.confirm: Availability, staffing and the quotation depend on your plan.

faqs.title: Can we see a complete wedding gallery?
faqs.answer: A full gallery helps you judge consistency across preparation, family photographs, rituals and evening lighting. The photographs on this preview are curated highlights from different shoots, not one complete wedding.
faqs.confirm: Request a full gallery from a celebration similar to yours before booking.
faqs.keywords: entire album real wedding low light

faqs.title: Do we have to do a pre-wedding shoot?
faqs.answer: It is optional. It can be a chance to spend time together, become familiar with the camera and create photographs for yourselves or your invitations. You can also focus your coverage on the wedding celebrations.
faqs.confirm: Ask how adding or removing a session changes the proposed coverage.

faqs.title: Can we enquire about pre-wedding photographs without a film?
faqs.answer: Yes. The enquiry form lets you request photographs only, films only, or both. Selecting an option starts a discussion; it does not reserve a team or confirm a package.
faqs.confirm: The studio needs to confirm the available service combination and quotation.

faqs.title: How does guest count affect the team?
faqs.answer: Think about simultaneous events and important people as well as the total guest count. Two preparation locations or overlapping rituals may need different coverage from a single intimate ceremony.
faqs.confirm: Ask for the crew and lead assigned to each event in writing.

faqs.title: Are the displayed package prices a current quotation?
faqs.answer: The Silver, Gold and Premium figures are references transcribed from the original website on 20 November 2026. They help you compare the published collections. A current written proposal should confirm your dates, events, hours, crew, inclusions and total price.
faqs.confirm: Date availability, taxes and extra costs are not confirmed by this preview.
faqs.keywords: cost rate price silver gold premium

faqs.title: What costs should we include beyond the studio’s quote?
faqs.answer: Check venue or shoot fees, permissions, makeup and hair, outfits, props, crew travel and accommodation, local transport, additional hours, extra albums and taxes. Some may already be included or may not apply. Use the cost worksheet to record each once.
faqs.confirm: Get a written inclusion/exclusion list from the studio and each external supplier.
faqs.keywords: hidden charges total budget venue gst travel

faqs.title: Does Silver include a pre-wedding shoot and a sangeet?
faqs.answer: The original Silver artwork says pre-wedding OR sangeet. It should not be interpreted as both being included.
faqs.confirm: Confirm which event you are choosing, the hours included and the cost of any addition.

faqs.title: Does 100, 150 or 200 premium edited photos mean the entire gallery?
faqs.answer: The published collections list those quantities as premium edited photographs. The artwork does not clearly establish whether these are the entire delivered gallery or a selected level of retouching.
faqs.confirm: Ask for total delivered JPEGs, specially retouched images and album selections as separate quantities.
faqs.keywords: all raw dump count pictures retouch

faqs.title: What do the two albums in a collection mean?
faqs.answer: The published Gold and Premium references list two albums. Their sizes and page counts are shown on the prices page. Identical copies, separate selections and separate designs are different products.
faqs.confirm: Confirm which version the studio includes and how extra pages or copies are charged.

faqs.title: How do payments and booking confirmation work?
faqs.answer: Before paying, request a written proposal with the event schedule, deliverables, payment stages and what reserves the dates. The form on this website prepares an enquiry; it does not take a payment or confirm a booking.
faqs.confirm: The studio must supply its current payment schedule and confirmation process.

faqs.title: What happens if our wedding or shoot date changes?
faqs.answer: Tell the studio as soon as the plan changes. Studio availability and venue or travel bookings may need to be revisited separately.
faqs.confirm: Ask for the written rescheduling, cancellation and refund terms before booking. No particular outcome is promised here.

faqs.title: How long should our pre-wedding session be?
faqs.answer: Build the session around usable photography time. Travel, outfit changes, hair and makeup, entry checks and breaks all use part of the day. The schedule worksheet helps you see the trade-offs before choosing too many stops.
faqs.confirm: The final duration and coverage hours belong in your proposal.
faqs.keywords: half day full day hours duration

faqs.title: How many outfits should we bring?
faqs.answer: Choose a manageable number that you can move, sit and walk in comfortably. Each change also needs somewhere private and time for adjustments. Use the schedule worksheet to check whether your changes fit the session.
faqs.confirm: Confirm included outfit changes and changing arrangements for your chosen location.

faqs.title: Are makeup, hair, clothes and props included?
faqs.answer: These are separate planning items unless your proposal explicitly includes them. Tell the studio whether you want help arranging them, then confirm who books and pays each supplier.
faqs.confirm: This preview does not promise rental outfits, a makeup artist or props.

faqs.title: We feel awkward in front of a camera. What should we do?
faqs.answer: Tell the photographer what feels comfortable and share a few references you like. Walking, talking or spending time together can be an easier starting point than holding an unfamiliar pose. You can also explain any movements or closeness you prefer to avoid.
faqs.confirm: Discuss the lead photographer’s approach to direction before booking.

faqs.title: How should we choose a shoot location?
faqs.answer: Start with the setting you connect with, then consider travel, walking, privacy, changing rooms, toilets, shade, permissions and a weather alternative. A beautiful location is only useful if the day works for both of you.
faqs.confirm: Check current access and facilities with the exact property or authority.

faqs.title: Does an entry ticket allow a professional photoshoot?
faqs.answer: Do not assume so. A venue may have a separate professional photo/video booking, crew limit or charge. Our location guides link to official information where available.
faqs.confirm: Agree who arranges permission and obtain current venue approval before travelling.

faqs.title: What if it rains or the weather is uncomfortable?
faqs.answer: Discuss an indoor alternative, a different time or a backup date while planning. The couple, studio and venue should agree which conditions would change the plan.
faqs.confirm: The studio’s written policy determines rescheduling costs and availability.
faqs.keywords: rain monsoon heat wind bad weather

faqs.title: What time of day should we shoot?
faqs.answer: The right time depends on the light, access hours, crowd levels, weather and the look you want. A plan can include morning, shaded daylight or evening scenes. Exact times need the date and location.
faqs.confirm: Confirm venue opening and the photographer’s lighting plan; no universal sunrise or sunset time is assumed.
faqs.keywords: golden hour season winter summer night

faqs.title: How early should we do the pre-wedding shoot?
faqs.answer: Work backwards from when you need the finished material. Invitations, a wedding website or a screening need time for the shoot, editing, any agreed revisions and your own final preparation.
faqs.confirm: Ask the studio to confirm that your required delivery date is achievable.
faqs.keywords: months weeks save date invitation deadline

faqs.title: What should we carry on the shoot?
faqs.answer: Bring your agreed outfits, comfortable footwear for walking, small touch-up items, water, snacks and any personal props you have discussed. Check changing arrangements and leave time for breaks.
faqs.confirm: Use the preparation checklist and adapt it to the venue, weather and your own needs.

faqs.title: Can we discuss walking, access or privacy needs?
faqs.answer: Yes. Share practical requirements such as fewer stairs, short transfers, a private changing space, regular breaks or a quieter setting. You do not need to explain private medical details in an enquiry.
faqs.confirm: Confirm the actual venue facilities before choosing the route.
faqs.keywords: wheelchair stairs rest mobility health private

faqs.title: Who will actually photograph and film our wedding?
faqs.answer: Ask to meet or speak with the lead people proposed for your celebration, and see work relevant to the events they will cover. The person answering an enquiry may not be the person assigned to every event.
faqs.confirm: Names, roles, crew per event and any substitution process need studio confirmation.
faqs.keywords: owner team junior staff lead shooter

faqs.title: How can we plan photographs with our parents and family?
faqs.answer: Make a short prioritised group list and choose someone who knows the family to help gather people. Share important combinations and any timing constraints before the wedding. Our family-photo worksheet can help.
faqs.confirm: The plan improves coordination; it cannot guarantee every photograph regardless of timing or attendance.
faqs.keywords: shot list parents siblings relatives missed

faqs.title: Can you cover the bride and groom getting ready separately?
faqs.answer: Share both locations and their schedules. Overlapping preparation and travel between venues affects how the crew should be arranged.
faqs.confirm: Confirm who covers each location and whether an additional photographer or filmmaker is needed.

faqs.title: What happens if an event runs late?
faqs.answer: Build some breathing room into the schedule and agree a family or planner contact for changes. Coverage hours and overtime should be clear before the event.
faqs.confirm: Ask when the coverage clock starts, when it ends and how extra hours are approved and charged.

faqs.title: What backup arrangements should we discuss?
faqs.answer: Ask separately about spare equipment, a lead-team absence, how files are copied after the event and how long delivered material is retained. These are different parts of the backup plan.
faqs.confirm: The studio must confirm its actual process; this preview does not assert a particular backup system.
faqs.keywords: equipment lost data sick emergency storage

faqs.title: How should photographers, filmmakers and content creators work together?
faqs.answer: Share the full vendor list and decide who coordinates timings and key positions. Family members can also help keep important sightlines clear during rituals.
faqs.confirm: Confirm whether the studio has any exclusivity or coordination conditions before hiring additional teams.

faqs.title: What is the difference between a reel, teaser, film and ceremony recording?
faqs.answer: A reel is a short social-format edit. A teaser introduces the celebration. A highlight or cinematic film selects moments into a story. A ceremony recording aims to document agreed rituals continuously. One does not automatically include the others.
faqs.confirm: Confirm duration, quantity, orientation and full-ceremony or performance coverage in writing.
faqs.keywords: long video full ritual speeches dance documentary

faqs.title: When will our photographs, films and albums arrive?
faqs.answer: Treat the first preview, full edited gallery, teaser, main film and albums as separate milestones. Album production may also depend on your selection and approval.
faqs.confirm: The studio has not supplied confirmed delivery dates for this preview. Get each milestone and the update contact in your proposal.
faqs.keywords: turnaround deadline weeks late ghosting timeline

faqs.title: What do RAW files and unedited JPEGs mean?
faqs.answer: Camera RAW files are camera-source image files. JPEGs are exported or camera-processed image files. An unedited JPEG is not the same as a camera RAW file. The original package artwork’s phrase raw photos in JPEG needs clarification.
faqs.confirm: Confirm file formats, selected quantities and any extra charges before booking.
faqs.keywords: raws originals all pictures data dump

faqs.title: How are skin tones, outfit colours and retouching handled?
faqs.answer: Look at complete examples in lighting similar to yours and explain the colours and finish you prefer. General colour adjustments and detailed skin retouching are different levels of editing.
faqs.confirm: Ask what editing is included, what requires approval and how extra retouching is charged.
faqs.keywords: natural skin whitening smoothing colour color grade

faqs.title: Can we request changes to photographs or films?
faqs.answer: Agree a feedback process, the number of revision rounds and the point at which an edit is considered approved. Give consolidated feedback so the team can address it clearly.
faqs.confirm: Included revisions, extra charges and deadlines need the studio’s confirmation.

faqs.title: Can we discuss the music and sound in our film?
faqs.answer: Share music references, important voices and performances you want preserved. Ask how music is selected and how the final film will be used or shared.
faqs.confirm: The studio must confirm the music arrangement and any options or limitations.
faqs.keywords: song soundtrack speeches vows audio copyright

faqs.title: Can we ask for our photographs and films to stay private?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can state a privacy preference in the enquiry and discuss it before booking. Getting-ready material, guest photographs, social posts and publication can be addressed separately.
faqs.confirm: The studio must agree the publishing and permission terms in writing. A checkbox here is a request, not an agreed contract.
faqs.keywords: social media instagram consent private no post

faqs.title: How will we receive files and how long will they remain available?
faqs.answer: Confirm the delivery method, download resolution, who can access the gallery and its expiry or retention period. Once delivered, keep your own copies of the files you want to preserve.
faqs.confirm: The studio has not confirmed a hosting, retention or recovery promise for this preview.
faqs.keywords: download drive link password backup expiry guests

faqs.title: How do album selections and approvals work?
faqs.answer: Agree who selects the photographs, the album specifications, how layout approval happens and when printing starts. A parent copy, extra pages and a separate design can affect the cost.
faqs.confirm: Ask for the selection deadline, revision allowance and production timeline.

locations.name: Kolkata
locations.description: A city setting for a story close to home, from familiar streets to a privately booked indoor or heritage setting.
locations.intro: Start with the look you love, then choose the exact property or route. A city shoot can work around travel, crowds and a convenient changing base.
planning: Session shape
Planning example: one neighbourhood or property, with time for changing and a break. Add transfers explicitly if you want more than one stop.
Light and weather
Discuss morning, shaded daylight or evening looks with the photographer. Keep an indoor option for the actual forecast.
Facilities
Changing rooms, toilets, shade, seating and parking depend on the exact venue. Confirm them before booking.
Permissions and costs
Professional shooting may need a separate booking from normal entry. Private heritage properties set their own access and crew rules.
locations.sourceName: Eco Park official professional shoot booking
locations.sourceNote: As one specific Kolkata-area example, Eco Park’s official page lists a pre-wedding photo/video fee of ₹10,000 plus GST and a three-camera limit. This is not a fee for every Kolkata location or a studio package. Reconfirm the current terms directly.

locations.name: Purulia
locations.description: Open landscapes and a journey with room to slow down. Plan the route around the actual locations you choose.
locations.intro: Purulia is a district, not a single shoot venue. Choose a manageable route rather than attempting every scenic stop in one session.
planning: Session shape
Planning example: agree a limited route and keep travel, changing and photography as separate time blocks. Confirm whether an overnight stay is practical.
Terrain and access
Walking, stairs, road access and distance from a changing base vary by stop. Tell the team what pace is comfortable.
Facilities
Do not assume toilets, changing rooms, water or seating at an outdoor stop. Confirm a suitable base with your accommodation or property.
Permissions and weather
Ask the relevant location or land manager about shooting access. Confirm weather and an alternative before leaving.
locations.sourceNote: The district’s tourism page provides destination context. It does not establish photography permission, a shoot fee or facility availability for your route.

locations.name: Mandarmani
locations.description: A coastal setting for a quieter story together. Keep the route, weather and changing arrangements simple.
locations.intro: A beach session needs a comfortable base and a plan for the actual conditions. Decide what can be done within the available light and access.
planning: Session shape
Planning example: a nearby accommodation or agreed changing base, a beach session and a rest or outfit-change buffer.
Weather and water
Discuss the forecast, wind, beach access and tide conditions with the local team. Keep activities within comfortable, permitted areas.
Facilities
Ask your chosen property about changing rooms, toilets, parking, meals and the photography areas you may use.
Permissions and costs
Accommodation, private property access and professional shoot arrangements may be separate. Confirm each supplier’s terms.
locations.sourceNote: The tourism page supplies destination information. It is not permission for a professional shoot or a current quotation from a property.

locations.name: Dubai
locations.description: Architecture and city scale, with an international plan that needs careful coordination.
locations.intro: The portfolio shows previous photographs in Dubai. A new international shoot depends on current studio availability, travel arrangements and the exact location approvals.
planning: Session shape
Planning example: a small number of city locations, planned around travel, access and changing. Avoid treating a whole city as one uninterrupted shoot.
Travel and crew
Confirm flights, accommodation, local transport and who organises the proposed crew’s arrangements.
Location and activity approvals
Confirm the exact shoot classification with the local authority and each property. Drone activity requires its own assessment; it is not automatically included.
Comfort and alternatives
Choose suitable times, a nearby changing base, rest breaks and an indoor alternative with the local team.
locations.sourceName: Dubai Film and TV Commission · official FAQ
locations.sourceNote: DFTC lists exemptions for weddings and personal filming, while other production activities have different requirements. Confirm how the exact planned shoot is classified and obtain any location-owner approvals; do not assume a blanket permission.
checks: Travel and stay for each person
